findings.summary: The 1.4s hero entrance moves the headline and intro 80px and scales them, with no prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
findings.fix: Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule that swaps the rise animation for a short opacity fade or none.

findings.summary: The background video autoplays and loops forever, with no pause control and no reduced-motion check.
findings.fix: Show a poster frame and skip autoplay when matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') matches, and add a visible pause button.

findings.summary: The scroll-linked parallax layer moves at 0.6x scroll speed even when the user has asked for reduced motion.
findings.fix: Only attach the parallax listener when prefers-reduced-motion is not set to reduce.

findings.summary: The scroll handler is not passive and writes a transform on every scroll event instead of once per frame.
findings.fix: Register it with { passive: true } and batch the transform write in requestAnimationFrame.

findings.summary: The card hover animates top and width, which trigger layout, and all 24 cards carry will-change hints that include layout properties.
findings.fix: Animate transform: translateY(-8px) instead of top, transition only transform and box-shadow, and remove the blanket will-change.

findings.summary: On every scroll event the handler alternates getBoundingClientRect reads with style.width writes across 24 cards, which forces layout repeatedly (layout thrashing) and makes the grid reflow during scroll.
findings.fix: Drop the width change, or use an IntersectionObserver that toggles a class driving a transform.

findings.summary: The scroll progress bar animates width on every scroll event, which triggers layout each time.
findings.fix: Drive the bar with transform: scaleX() inside a requestAnimationFrame-throttled passive listener, or use a CSS scroll-driven animation.

findings.summary: The 'Learn more' links appear only on :hover, so touch users never see them.
findings.fix: Show the links by default and wrap the hover-only reveal in @media (hover: hover).

findings.summary: The 'Learn more' links stay at opacity 0 when a keyboard user tabs to them, so the focused element is invisible.
findings.fix: Add .card:focus-within .more { opacity: 1 } alongside the hover rule.

findings.summary: button:focus { outline: none } removes every visible focus indicator for keyboard users.
findings.fix: Remove the rule, or replace it with a clear :focus-visible outline.

findings.summary: Opening the modal does not move focus into the dialog, trap it there, or return it to the trigger on close, and the dialog has no role or aria-modal.
findings.fix: Use a native <dialog> with showModal(), or set role=dialog with aria-modal, focus the email input on open, and restore focus to the Sign up button on close.

findings.summary: The Escape key does not close the modal.
findings.fix: Add a keydown listener that calls closeModal() when Escape is pressed while the modal is open.

findings.summary: The open and close setTimeouts are never cancelled, so reopening within 350ms of closing lets the old timer remove .open and hide the modal that was just reopened; closing within 20ms of opening has the same race.
findings.fix: Keep the timer IDs and clearTimeout them on each open or close, or remove .open on the transitionend event after checking the modal is still meant to be closed.

findings.summary: The dialog's scale transition has no reduced-motion alternative.
findings.fix: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, keep only a short opacity transition and drop the scale.

findings.summary: The requestAnimationFrame counter loop is never cancelled: it keeps running after the tab switches to About, and each remount of Stats starts another loop that runs forever.
findings.fix: Store the rAF id, stop the loop at a target value, and call cancelAnimationFrame in an unmount step that runs before panel.innerHTML is replaced.

findings.summary: The counter keeps changing every frame no matter the user's motion preference, so the number never settles enough to read.
findings.fix: Under prefers-reduced-motion, render the final value directly, and otherwise ease to a fixed target over a bounded duration.

findings.summary: A new IntersectionObserver is created on every mount and never disconnected, so observers pile up on detached nodes.
findings.fix: Call unobserve after the element reveals, and disconnect the observer when the panel unmounts.

findings.summary: Each mount adds another resize listener that is never removed, so listeners pile up and keep holding references to detached counter nodes.
findings.fix: Use a named handler and remove it on unmount, or use a CSS media query for the font size.

findings.summary: touch-action: none on html and body stops touch users from scrolling or zooming the page at all.
findings.fix: Remove it from html and body, and if needed set touch-action: pan-y only on the carousel track.

findings.summary: The navigation dots appear only on :hover, so touch users cannot see them.
findings.fix: Show the controls by default, and limit any hover-only reveal to @media (hover: hover).

findings.summary: The dots are plain divs with click handlers, so keyboard users cannot focus or activate them, and they have no accessible names.
findings.fix: Use <button> elements with aria-labels such as 'Show testimonial 2' and a visible focus style, which also makes the controls visible on :focus-within.

findings.summary: The carousel auto-advances every 3s forever, ignoring reduced-motion preferences, with no pause control and no pause on hover or focus.
findings.fix: Turn off autoplay under prefers-reduced-motion, add a pause/play button, and pause while the carousel is hovered or focused.

findings.summary: The autoplay interval does not reset after a dot click or swipe, so a slide the user just picked can be replaced almost at once.
findings.fix: Clear and restart the interval in go() on any user navigation, or stop autoplay after the user interacts.

findings.summary: The 0.5s slide transition plays even when the user prefers reduced motion.
findings.fix: Set transition: none, or a short crossfade, on .track under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
